# Crewdays: full text

> Every page of crewdays.app as plain text. Figures are calculated from each shift cycle; rules are cited to official sources. Updated 2026-10-17.

## Shift Schedule Calendar 2027: Pitman, DuPont, 24/48, Kelly (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/

Your shift calendar for the whole year
Choose your pattern and a day you start work. You get all 12 months, your hours, a link your family can open and a file for Google or Apple Calendar.

Which 12-hour shift schedule is right for you?
All of these cover 24/7 with 12-hour shifts. Pick by what matters to you: full weekends off, a long break, short runs of shifts or staying on the same shift.
| | Pattern | Full weekends off in 2027* | Longest break | Most shifts in a row | Nights | Hours a week | Crews
| Pitman | 26 | 3 days | 3 | Fixed days or nights | 42 | 4
| Panama | 26 | 3 days | 3 | Rotates days and nights | 42 | 4
| DuPont | 26 | 7 days | 4 | Rotates days and nights | 42 | 4
| 4 on 4 off | 21 | 4 days | 4 | Fixed days or nights | 42 | 4
| 3 on 3 off | 17 | 3 days | 3 | Fixed days or nights | 42 | 4
| 2 on 2 off | 13 | 2 days | 2 | Fixed days or nights | 42 | 4
| 7 on 7 off | 26 | 7 days | 7 | Fixed days or nights | 42 | 4
*One crew, cycle starting Monday, January 4, 2027. The Pitman, Panama and DuPont give the most full weekends off (every other one on the Pitman and Panama); the DuPont adds a full week off; for no more than two shifts in a row, 2 on 2 off. Patterns with "rotates" switch each crew between days and nights; the others can keep crews on fixed shifts. More detail, overtime and police options: 12-hour shift schedule examples.

Use it as a free shift calendar app
Crewdays installs on your phone like an app, with no app store and no account. On iPhone, open crewdays.app in Safari, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open it in Chrome and choose Install app or Add to home screen in the menu. It opens full screen, works offline once it has loaded, and keeps your calendar on your phone. To see your shifts in Google Calendar or Apple Calendar, press Add to calendar on any calendar page.

Figures are worked out from each cycle; rules checked against official sources on October 17, 2026. How we calculate
Questions
Do I need an account?
No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing you type is sent anywhere.
Is there a Crewdays app for iPhone or Android?
Yes, without the app store. On iPhone, open crewdays.app in Safari, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open it in Chrome and choose Install app or Add to home screen in the menu. It opens full screen, works offline once it has loaded, and is free.
My pattern is not listed. What can I do?
Choose "Build your own" and type your cycle, one letter per day: D for day, N for night, E for evening, X for 24 hours and O for off.
What is the best rotating shift schedule?
There is no single best one. The Pitman and Panama give every other weekend off, the DuPont gives a full week off every four weeks, and 24/48 or 48/96 suit 24-hour services. Compare them side by side on the comparison pages.
Do you get paid more for working nights?
Federal law (the FLSA) does not require extra pay for nights or weekends. Night differentials come from your employer, union contract or, in a few cases, state rules. When you do get one, it counts towards your overtime rate.
Is three 12-hour shifts a week full time?
Usually, but it depends on the employer. Federal law has no single definition of full time; many employers and the Affordable Care Act use 30 hours a week or more, and 36 hours counts as full time at many hospitals.
Can it work out California overtime on 12-hour shifts?
Yes. In "Your pay" choose the California rule: over 8 hours a day at time and a half, over 12 at double time, plus weekly overtime over 40 hours and the seventh day in a row (California Labor Code 510). Alaska (over 8 a day, AS 23.10.060; hospital employees who provide medical services are exempt) and Colorado (over 12 hours in a workday or 12 consecutive hours, COMPS Order #40, Rule 4) are there too.
Which holidays are marked?
The 11 US federal holidays on their actual date. Your employer may give the day off on a different date when a holiday falls on a weekend.
Can I see every crew at once?
Yes. Under "Show" choose "All crews" to see which crew is on each shift every day, as on a station or plant calendar.
Does it work for night shifts that cross midnight?
Yes. Each shift is shown on the day it starts.

---

## Pitman Schedule (2-2-3) Calendar 2027: Free Generator
URL: https://crewdays.app/pitman-schedule/

Home / Pitman Schedule
Pitman Schedule Calendar
The Pitman schedule is a 12-hour shift pattern that repeats every 14 days: 2 days on, 2 off, 3 on, 2 off, 2 on, 3 off. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
Pitman Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 14 days
Shift length: 12 hours
Crews for 24/7: 4
Hours a week: 42
Hours a year: 2,190
Days off per cycle: 7
What is a Pitman schedule?
The Pitman schedule is a 12-hour shift pattern that repeats every 14 days: 2 days on, 2 off, 3 on, 2 off, 2 on, 3 off. It is often called the 2-2-3 schedule. Two crews cover the day shift and two cover nights, so four crews give 24/7 coverage.
One cycle, crew by crew
Day shift (14 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day
Night shift (14 days)
Crew A: Night, Night, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night
Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your Pitman schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 14-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable Pitman schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a Pitman schedule
A Pitman schedule needs four crews to cover 24/7: two work days and two work nights, each on the same 14-day cycle. Shifts usually run 6 to 6 or 7 to 7. Read the cycle as two on, two off, three on, then the same again starting with two off.
If your crew's cycle starts on a Monday, you work Monday, Tuesday and Friday to Sunday in the first week, and Wednesday and Thursday in the second. So you work one weekend from Friday to Sunday and have the next one off, every other week.
Police departments often keep crews on fixed days or fixed nights. Plants more often rotate crews between days and nights every few weeks; with a switch every 14 days it becomes the Panama rotation. Before you start, ask which crew you are on, the date your crew's cycle began and which day your employer's workweek starts, because that decides how much overtime you get (see the table below).
Overtime on a Pitman schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 7 shifts every 14 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:
| | Workweek starts | Hours in each week | Overtime hours a year
| Monday | 60, 24 | 520
| Tuesday | 48, 36 | 208
| Wednesday | 36, 48 | 208
| Thursday | 48, 36 | 208
| Friday | 60, 24 | 520
| Saturday | 48, 36 | 208
| Sunday | 36, 48 | 208
Compare this pattern with every other 24/7 option in 24/7 shift schedules compared. Federal rule only, before leave and swaps. Daily overtime states such as California count differently: use “Your pay” in the calendar or the shift pay calculator.
How many hours is a Pitman schedule?
| | Version | Cycle | Crews | Avg hours a week | Hours a year
| Day shift | 14 days | 2 | 42 | 2,190
| Night shift | 14 days | 2 | 42 | 2,190
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Day shift: 84 h × 365 ÷ 14 = 2,190 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.
Pitman pay calculator: hours, overtime and pay a year at your hourly rate.
Pitman Schedule pros and cons
Pros
Every other weekend is a full three-day weekend.
Never more than 3 shifts in a row.
Same shift times all year if your crew stays on days or nights.
Cons
12-hour shifts are long, especially on nights.
The days you work change from week to week, which makes childcare harder to plan.
Fixed-night crews never rotate back to days unless the employer adds a rotation.

An example year with Crew A starting its cycle on Monday, January 4, 2027; the other crews follow 7 days apart. For your own dates, use the calendar at the top of the page.
| | Crew | Shifts in 2027 | Hours | Full weekends off
| A | 182 | 2,184 | 26
| B | 183 | 2,196 | 26

Who uses the Pitman schedule?
Police departments, manufacturing plants, 911 dispatch and security teams.

Questions
How many hours a week is a Pitman schedule?
On average 42 hours a week: 7 shifts of 12 hours every 14 days. Over a year that is about 2,190 scheduled hours, before overtime, leave or Kelly days.
How many crews does a Pitman schedule need?
2 crews for this version, with exactly one crew on each shift every day.
How many hours a year is a Pitman schedule?
About 2,190 scheduled hours a year: about 183 shifts of 12 hours. Overtime, leave and shift swaps change your own total; the pay calculator works it out at your hourly rate.
How long is the Pitman schedule cycle?
14 days. After that the same days repeat, so the calendar for any year follows from one start date.
How do I add my Pitman schedule shifts to Google Calendar or my iPhone?
Pick a day you start a block, press "Add to calendar" and open the file. It adds your Pitman schedule shifts, about 183 a year, as all-day events that Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook import, so daylight saving time does not move them.
Can my family see my schedule?
Yes. Press "Copy link" ("Share" on a phone) and send it. The link holds your Pitman schedule crew and start date, so it opens the same calendar on any phone. Nobody needs an account.
Can I download it to Excel?
Yes. Press "Excel" to download the year as a CSV file that opens in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers. With "All crews" selected you get one column for each of the 2 crews (A, B), ready to print or post for the whole team.

Panama Schedule Calendar

What is a Panama schedule?
The Panama schedule uses the same 2-2-3 rhythm as the Pitman, but each crew rotates: 14 days on day shifts, then 14 days on night shifts, for a 28-day cycle. Four crews cover 24/7 with 12-hour shifts.
One cycle, crew by crew
Rotating days/nights (28 days)

Printable Panama schedule template

Working a Panama schedule
The Panama schedule uses the 2-2-3 rhythm of the Pitman but moves every crew between days and nights: 14 days on day shifts, then 14 days on nights, a 28-day cycle with four crews. Everyone works the same number of nights, which is the main reason employers choose it over a fixed Pitman.
The hard part is the change itself. Every two weeks you have to move your sleep from nights to days or back. The change comes after a three-day break, which helps, but plan the first day of that break as a recovery day.
Over a year each crew works about 91 day shifts and 91 night shifts. If your employer pays a night differential, it is spread evenly across all crews, so pay is the same for everyone with the same hourly rate.
Overtime on a Panama schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 14 shifts every 28 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:
| | Workweek starts | Hours in each week | Overtime hours a year
| Monday | 60, 24 | 520
| Tuesday | 48, 36 | 208
| Wednesday | 36, 48 | 208
| Thursday | 48, 36 | 208
| Friday | 60, 24 | 520
| Saturday | 48, 36 | 208
| Sunday | 36, 48 | 208

Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Rotating days/nights: 168 h × 365 ÷ 28 = 2,190 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.

Panama Schedule pros and cons
Pros
Every other weekend off, as on the Pitman.
Everyone shares the night shifts fairly.
No stretch longer than 3 shifts.
Cons
Switching from days to nights every two weeks is hard on sleep.
Work days move around, so you need the calendar to know your week.
Some sites call a different 2-3-2 pattern "Panama": check yours against the strip below.

DuPont Schedule Calendar
The DuPont schedule is a 28-day rotating pattern with 12-hour shifts and four crews: 4 nights, 3 off, 3 days, 1 off, 3 nights, 3 off, 4 days, then 7 days off. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
DuPont Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 28 days
Shift length: 12 hours
Crews for 24/7: 4
Hours a week: 42
Hours a year: 2,190
Days off per cycle: 14
What is a DuPont schedule?
The DuPont schedule is a 28-day rotating pattern with 12-hour shifts and four crews: 4 nights, 3 off, 3 days, 1 off, 3 nights, 3 off, 4 days, then 7 days off. The 7-day break is what most people choose it for.
One cycle, crew by crew
Rotating days/nights (28 days)
Crew A: Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off
Crew C: Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night
Crew D: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day
Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your DuPont schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 28-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable DuPont schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a DuPont schedule
The name comes from the DuPont company, and the pattern is still common in chemical plants, refineries, power stations and manufacturing: places that never stop, where four crews share days and nights equally.
The 7-day break is the reason people like it. It can be stretched with very little leave: the 4 day shifts before the break sit between 3 days off and the 7 off, so taking those 4 shifts as leave gives 14 days off in a row.
The price is the middle of the cycle. Three day shifts, one day off and then three nights is one of the hardest changes in common 12-hour patterns, and the weeks are very uneven: depending on where your workweek starts, you can work 72 hours in one week and none in another. That makes the DuPont one of the most expensive patterns in weekly overtime, as the table below shows.
Overtime on a DuPont schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 14 shifts every 28 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:
| | Workweek starts | Hours in each week | Overtime hours a year
| Monday | 48, 72, 48, 0 | 624
| Tuesday | 48, 60, 48, 12 | 468
| Wednesday | 48, 48, 48, 24 | 312
| Thursday | 48, 36 | 208
| Friday | 36, 48 | 208
| Saturday | 48, 48, 24, 48 | 312
| Sunday | 60, 48, 12, 48 | 468
Compare this pattern with every other 24/7 option in 24/7 shift schedules compared. Federal rule only, before leave and swaps. Daily overtime states such as California count differently: use “Your pay” in the calendar or the shift pay calculator.

DuPont Schedule pros and cons
Pros
A full week off every four weeks.
Each crew works days and nights in equal measure.
Average of 42 hours a week.
Cons
The 4-shift blocks are tiring, and the week before the break is heavy.
Quick swaps between nights and days.
Employers often change the order of the blocks: compare with your rota.

## 4 on 4 off Schedule Calendar 2027: Free Shift Pattern
URL: https://crewdays.app/4-on-4-off-schedule/

Home / 4 on 4 off Schedule
4 on 4 off Schedule Calendar
On a 4 on 4 off schedule you work four 12-hour shifts and then get four days off, an 8-day cycle. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
4 on 4 off Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 8 days
Shift length: 12 hours
Crews for 24/7: 4
Hours a week: 42
Hours a year: 2,190
Days off per cycle: 4
What is a 4 on 4 off schedule?
On a 4 on 4 off schedule you work four 12-hour shifts and then get four days off, an 8-day cycle. With days only, two crews cover the day shift; the rotating version adds 4 nights after the 4 days off, a 16-day cycle for four crews.
One cycle, crew by crew
Days only (8 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day
Rotating days/nights (16 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day
Crew C: Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew D: Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night
Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your 4 on 4 off schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 8-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable 4 on 4 off schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a 4 on 4 off schedule
Two crews cover the day shifts and, in 24/7 plants, two more cover nights. Because the cycle is 8 days, one more than a week, your working days move one day later each week, so every crew gets weekends off in turn.
A popular rotating version adds nights: 4 days, 4 off, 4 nights, 4 off, a 16-day cycle. The four days off after the nights are partly lost to sleep, so the real break feels shorter than on paper.
With four shifts of leave you get 12 days off in a row (4 off, 4 shifts of leave, 4 off). The weeks alternate between 4 shifts (48 hours) and 3 shifts (36 hours) in runs, so federal overtime comes in some weeks and not others.
Over any eight weeks Saturday and Sunday pass through every point of the cycle: three weekends are completely free, three are worked on both days and two are split. That is roughly 19 full weekends off a year.
Pay periods do not line up with the cycle either. Any 14 days hold 6, 7 or 8 shifts, so if you are paid by the hour on a biweekly payroll, a check can carry anything from 72 to 96 hours of base pay while the yearly total stays the same.
Overtime on a 4 on 4 off schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 4 shifts every 8 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:
| | Workweek starts | Hours in each week | Overtime hours a year
| Monday | 48, 48, 48, 48, 36, 36, 36, 36 | 208
| Tuesday | 36, 48, 48, 48, 48, 36, 36, 36 | 208
| Wednesday | 36, 36, 48, 48, 48, 48, 36, 36 | 208
| Thursday | 36, 36, 36, 48, 48, 48, 48, 36 | 208
| Friday | 36, 36, 36, 36, 48, 48, 48, 48 | 208
| Saturday | 48, 36, 36, 36, 36, 48, 48, 48 | 208
| Sunday | 48, 48, 36, 36, 36, 36, 48, 48 | 208

| Days only | 8 days | 2 | 42 | 2,190
| Rotating days/nights | 16 days | 4 | 42 | 2,190
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Days only: 48 h × 365 ÷ 8 = 2,190 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.

What is a 4-3-3-4 schedule?
The 4-3-3-4 schedule (4 on, 3 off, 3 on, 4 off) is a 14-day pattern of 12-hour shifts. Each crew works 7 shifts every two weeks. Coverage depends on how your employer lines the crews up, so it does not give one crew per shift every day on its own.
One cycle, crew by crew
Days only (14 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off

Working a 4-3-3-4 schedule
The 4 on 3 off schedule, also called 4-3-3-4, alternates a week of four 12-hour shifts with a week of three: 4 on, 3 off, 3 on, 4 off, a 14-day cycle. Every week has three or four days off in a row, and you work 84 hours every two weeks.
With two crews it does not cover every day of the week on its own; employers stagger the crews or add relief, so check who covers the days your crew is off. A rotating version adds a fortnight of nights after the fortnight of days.
The fixed rhythm makes it easy to plan childcare and classes: the same days repeat every two weeks. The weeks alternate between 48 and 36 hours, so with a normal Monday workweek there are 8 hours of federal overtime every other week.
Overtime on a 4-3-3-4 schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 7 shifts every 14 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:

| Monday | 48, 36 | 208
| Tuesday | 48, 36 | 208
| Wednesday | 48, 36 | 208
| Thursday | 48, 36 | 208
| Friday | 36, 48 | 208
| Saturday | 36, 48 | 208
| Sunday | 36, 48 | 208

In the UK the same name is used for 10-hour patterns.

Working a 3 on 3 off schedule
It is common in hospitals and care homes. Because the cycle is 6 days, one less than a week, your working days move one day earlier each week and you get every day of the week off in turn.
Do not confuse it with "three 12s a week", the usual hospital contract of 36 hours. 3 on 3 off averages 42 hours a week, because you work half of all days: about 182 shifts a year instead of about 156.
Weeks alternate in runs between 3 shifts (36 hours) and 4 shifts (48 hours), so overtime comes in some weeks and not others. In the rotating version, three days and three nights are separated by three days off, which gives time to change your sleep.
Weekends come back in a six-week rhythm: two completely free, two worked from Saturday to Sunday and two where only one of the days is a shift. In other words, one full weekend off in three, about 17 or 18 a year.
A short leave allowance stretches well here. Book the three shifts that sit between two breaks and you are away for nine days in a row: three off, three on leave, three off.
Overtime on a 3 on 3 off schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 3 shifts every 6 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:
| | Workweek starts | Hours in each week | Overtime hours a year
| Monday | 48, 48, 48, 36, 36, 36 | 208
| Tuesday | 48, 48, 36, 36, 36, 48 | 208
| Wednesday | 48, 36, 36, 36, 48, 48 | 208
| Thursday | 36, 36, 36, 48, 48, 48 | 208
| Friday | 36, 36, 48, 48, 48, 36 | 208
| Saturday | 36, 48, 48, 48, 36, 36 | 208
| Sunday | 48, 48, 48, 36, 36, 36 | 208

Working a 2 on 2 off schedule
The 2 on 2 off schedule is the simplest 12-hour pattern: two shifts, two days off, a 4-day cycle. You never work more than two long shifts in a row, which many people find easier on the body than blocks of three or four.
The days off are short, though. Two days rarely feel like a real break, especially after nights, and the pattern gives fewer full weekends than the Pitman or Panama, which group the off days into a three-day weekend.
Many employers turn the 2-2 into a 2-2-3 by adding a three-day block every week; that is the Pitman. If your rota looks like 2 on 2 off with an occasional 3, check the Pitman calendar too.
Saturdays and Sundays follow a four-week rhythm: one weekend in four is completely free, one is two working days and in the other two you work one of them. That adds up to about 13 full weekends off a year, fewer than on longer patterns with the same hours.
Leave goes further than it looks: the two shifts between two breaks cost two days of leave and give six days off in a row. Over a year you work about 183 shifts, close to 2,200 hours.
Overtime on a 2 on 2 off schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 2 shifts every 4 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:

| Monday | 48, 48, 36, 36 | 208
| Tuesday | 36, 48, 48, 36 | 208
| Wednesday | 36, 36, 48, 48 | 208
| Thursday | 48, 36, 36, 48 | 208
| Friday | 48, 48, 36, 36 | 208
| Saturday | 36, 48, 48, 36 | 208
| Sunday | 36, 36, 48, 48 | 208

What is a 7 on 7 off schedule?
A 7 on 7 off schedule is seven shifts in a row followed by seven days off, a 14-day cycle. Shifts are usually 12 hours, so you work 84 hours every two weeks, an average of 42 a week. Two crews cover the day shift; the rotating version is a week of days, a week off, a week of nights and a week off, a 28-day cycle for four crews.
One cycle, crew by crew
Days only (14 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day
Rotating days/nights (28 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day
Crew C: Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew D: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night, Night

Printable 7 on 7 off schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a 7 on 7 off schedule
Under the standard rule, overtime is paid for hours over 40 in a workweek. If all seven 12-hour shifts fall in one workweek, 44 of the 84 hours are overtime; if your employer's workweek splits the block into four shifts and three, only the 48-hour week has overtime, 8 hours. Ask payroll which day the workweek starts, then turn on "Your pay" to see it for your dates.
Hospitals can agree with their staff to use a 14-day period instead of the workweek (the 8/80 system). Overtime is then due for hours over 8 in a workday and over 80 in the 14 days, so each 12-hour shift has 4 hours of overtime (29 CFR 778.601).
Two crews cover one position on days; four crews cover days and nights. If you prefer longer blocks with the same half year at home, the 14 on 14 off hitch rotation used on oil rigs and mines is the same even-time idea: see the hitch rotation calendar.
Overtime on a 7 on 7 off schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 7 shifts every 14 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:
| | Workweek starts | Hours in each week | Overtime hours a year
| Monday | 84, 0 | 1,144
| Tuesday | 72, 12 | 832
| Wednesday | 60, 24 | 520
| Thursday | 48, 36 | 208
| Friday | 36, 48 | 208
| Saturday | 24, 60 | 520
| Sunday | 12, 72 | 832
Compare this pattern with every other 24/7 option in 24/7 shift schedules compared. Federal rule only, before leave and swaps. Daily overtime states such as California count differently: use “Your pay” in the calendar or the shift pay calculator.
How many hours is a 7 on 7 off schedule?
| | Version | Cycle | Crews | Avg hours a week | Hours a year
| Days only | 14 days | 2 | 42 | 2,190
| Rotating days/nights | 28 days | 4 | 42 | 2,190
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Days only: 84 h × 365 ÷ 14 = 2,190 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.
7 on 7 off pay calculator: hours, overtime and pay a year at your hourly rate.
7 on 7 off Schedule pros and cons
Pros
A full week off every other week.
Half the days of the year at home.
Because the cycle is exactly two weeks, your week on always starts on the same weekday.
Cons
Seven 12-hour shifts in a row are exhausting, especially on nights.
You work every other weekend in full.
How much overtime you get depends on where your employer's workweek starts (see below).

Hospitals, security, oil and gas, and some police and ambulance services.

Questions
How many hours a week is a 7 on 7 off schedule?
On average 42 hours a week: 7 shifts of 12 hours every 14 days. Over a year that is about 2,190 scheduled hours, before overtime, leave or Kelly days.
How many crews does a 7 on 7 off schedule need?
2 crews for this version, with exactly one crew on each shift every day.
How many hours a year is a 7 on 7 off schedule?
About 2,190 scheduled hours a year: about 183 shifts of 12 hours. Overtime, leave and shift swaps change your own total; the pay calculator works it out at your hourly rate.
How long is the 7 on 7 off schedule cycle?
14 days. After that the same days repeat, so the calendar for any year follows from one start date.
How do I add my 7 on 7 off schedule shifts to Google Calendar or my iPhone?
Pick a day you start a block, press "Add to calendar" and open the file. It adds your 7 on 7 off schedule shifts, about 183 a year, as all-day events that Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook import, so daylight saving time does not move them.
Can my family see my schedule?
Yes. Press "Copy link" ("Share" on a phone) and send it. The link holds your 7 on 7 off schedule crew and start date, so it opens the same calendar on any phone. Nobody needs an account.
Can I download it to Excel?
Yes. Press "Excel" to download the year as a CSV file that opens in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers. With "All crews" selected you get one column for each of the 2 crews (A, B), ready to print or post for the whole team.

## 24/48 Schedule Calendar 2027: Hours, Kelly Days, Free
URL: https://crewdays.app/24-48-schedule/

Home / 24/48 Schedule
24/48 Schedule Calendar
On a 24/48 schedule you work one 24-hour shift and then have 48 hours off, a 3-day cycle. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
24/48 Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 3 days
Shift length: 24 hours
Crews for 24/7: 3
Hours a week: 56
Hours a year: 2,920
Days off per cycle: 2
What is a 24/48 schedule?
On a 24/48 schedule you work one 24-hour shift and then have 48 hours off, a 3-day cycle. Three platoons, usually called A, B and C shift, cover every day of the year.
One cycle, crew by crew
Standard (3 days)
Crew A: 24h, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, 24h
Crew C: Off, 24h, Off
Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your 24/48 schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 3-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable 24/48 schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a 24/48 schedule
The 24/48 is the most common schedule in US fire departments. You work 24 hours, usually 7 a.m. to 7 a.m. or 8 a.m. to 8 a.m., and then have 48 hours off. Three platoons, A, B and C, take turns, so the station is staffed every day of the year.
Firefighters are usually paid under section 7(k) of the FLSA, with overtime after 212 hours in a 28-day work period instead of 40 a week. A 24/48 puts 9 or 10 shifts (216 or 240 hours) into any 28 days, so most work periods include some overtime; departments add Kelly days to bring that down.
Sleep at the station counts as working time on a shift of exactly 24 hours; it can only be excluded on shifts of more than 24 hours, by agreement (29 CFR 553.222). Ask your department how it counts calls during the night.
You never work a whole weekend: with a 3-day cycle only one of Saturday or Sunday can fall on your shift. Across any three weekends you work one Saturday, one Sunday and have one weekend completely free, and one shift of leave buys five days off in a row.
Trading shifts with another firefighter is allowed under the FLSA. If both of you agree freely and the department approves the trade before it happens, the hours you work as a substitute do not count toward overtime, and each of you is credited as if you had worked your normal schedule (29 CFR 553.31).
Overtime on a 24/48 schedule under 7(k)
Fire departments usually pay overtime under section 7(k) of the FLSA: after 212 hours in a 28-day work period (29 CFR 553.230). In any 28 days this cycle puts 9 or 10 shifts of 24 hours, so 216 or 240 hours, which is up to 28 hours over the threshold before Kelly days, swaps or callbacks.
Try your own work period in the 7(k) overtime calculator.
How many hours is a 24/48 schedule?
| | Version | Cycle | Crews | Avg hours a week | Hours a year
| Standard | 3 days | 3 | 56 | 2,920
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Standard: 24 h × 365 ÷ 3 = 2,920 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.
24/48 pay calculator: hours, overtime and pay a year at your hourly rate.
24/48 Schedule pros and cons
Pros
Two full days off after every shift.
Only about 122 shifts a year.
Simple and predictable.
Cons
Scheduled time is about 56 hours a week, 2,920 hours a year.
A bad night at the station runs straight into your days off.
Many departments add Kelly days to keep overtime down.

| C | 122 | 2,928 | 17
For all 12 months with your own start date, your crew and your holidays, use the calendar at the top of the page: you can print the year, download it to Excel or add it to your phone.

Fire departments and EMS.

## 48/96 Schedule Calendar 2027: Hours, Pros and Cons
URL: https://crewdays.app/48-96-schedule/

Home / 48/96 Schedule
48/96 Schedule Calendar
On a 48/96 schedule you work two 24-hour shifts back to back (48 hours) and then have 96 hours off, a 6-day cycle. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
48/96 Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 6 days
Shift length: 24 hours
Crews for 24/7: 3
Hours a week: 56
Hours a year: 2,920
Days off per cycle: 4
What is a 48/96 schedule?
On a 48/96 schedule you work two 24-hour shifts back to back (48 hours) and then have 96 hours off, a 6-day cycle. Three platoons cover 24/7. Several US fire departments moved to it in 2025 and 2026.
One cycle, crew by crew
Standard (6 days)
Crew A: 24h, 24h, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, Off, 24h, 24h
Crew C: Off, Off, 24h, 24h, Off, Off
Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your 48/96 schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 6-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable 48/96 schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a 48/96 schedule
The hours are the same as a 24/48, about 56 a week, but there are half as many commutes. That is why departments where many firefighters live far away, often in the western US, moved to it.
The concern is fatigue in the second 24 hours, especially at busy stations. If your department is considering it, ask how busy stations will be handled and what will be measured during a trial.
Under 7(k) a 48/96 puts 9 or 10 shifts into any 28-day work period, the same as a 24/48, so overtime is similar. Shift swaps are harder because the other person has to cover 48 hours.
A 48-hour tour is longer than 24 hours, which changes the sleep rule. Sleep time can then be left out of paid hours, but only with an express or implied agreement, never more than 8 hours in each 24, and calls that interrupt it count as work; if you cannot get at least 5 hours of sleep, the whole period counts (29 CFR 553.222(c)). Ask whether your department has such an agreement.
Weekends work out well: half of them are completely free and only one in six is spent on duty from Saturday to Sunday. Taking one 48-hour tour as leave gives ten days off in a row (four off, two on leave, four off).
Overtime on a 48/96 schedule under 7(k)
Fire departments usually pay overtime under section 7(k) of the FLSA: after 212 hours in a 28-day work period (29 CFR 553.230). In any 28 days this cycle puts 8 or 10 shifts of 24 hours, so 192 or 240 hours, which is up to 28 hours over the threshold before Kelly days, swaps or callbacks.
Try your own work period in the 7(k) overtime calculator.
How many hours is a 48/96 schedule?
| | Version | Cycle | Crews | Avg hours a week | Hours a year
| Standard | 6 days | 3 | 56 | 2,920
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Standard: 48 h × 365 ÷ 6 = 2,920 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.
48/96 pay calculator: hours, overtime and pay a year at your hourly rate.
48/96 Schedule pros and cons
Pros
Four full days off in every 6.
Fewer commutes, which suits people who live far from the station.
Same 56-hour average as a 24/48.
Cons
48 hours on duty is a long time without proper sleep.
Swapping shifts is harder in 48-hour blocks.
Studies on fatigue are mixed: ask your department what they measured.

## Kelly Schedule Calendar 2027 for Firefighters (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/kelly-schedule/

Home / Kelly Schedule
Kelly Schedule Calendar
The Kelly schedule is a 9-day firefighter pattern: 24 on, 24 off, 24 on, 24 off, 24 on, then 4 days off. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
Kelly Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 9 days
Shift length: 24 hours
Crews for 24/7: 3
Hours a week: 56
Hours a year: 2,920
Days off per cycle: 6
What is a Kelly schedule?
The Kelly schedule is a 9-day firefighter pattern: 24 on, 24 off, 24 on, 24 off, 24 on, then 4 days off. Three platoons cover 24/7. The name is also used for a "Kelly day", an extra shift off that departments give to cut weekly hours.
One cycle, crew by crew
Standard (9 days)
Crew A: 24h, Off, 24h, Off, 24h, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, 24h, Off, Off, Off, Off, 24h, Off, 24h
Crew C: Off, Off, Off, 24h, Off, 24h, Off, 24h, Off
Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your Kelly schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 9-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable Kelly schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a Kelly schedule
Compared with a 24/48, the Kelly groups the same work into three shifts in five days followed by a four-day break, instead of spacing every shift two days apart. Many firefighters like the long break; others find three 24-hour shifts in five days harder to recover from.
The word Kelly is also used for a Kelly day: an extra shift off, every so often, that departments give to bring average hours down. On this site you can add Kelly days to any 24-hour pattern in the calendar.
Under 7(k) the Kelly cycle puts 9 or 10 shifts into any 28 days, as a 24/48 does.
Overtime on a Kelly schedule under 7(k)
Fire departments usually pay overtime under section 7(k) of the FLSA: after 212 hours in a 28-day work period (29 CFR 553.230). In any 28 days this cycle puts 9 or 10 shifts of 24 hours, so 216 or 240 hours, which is up to 28 hours over the threshold before Kelly days, swaps or callbacks.
Try your own work period in the 7(k) overtime calculator.
How many hours is a Kelly schedule?
| | Version | Cycle | Crews | Avg hours a week | Hours a year
| Standard | 9 days | 3 | 56 | 2,920
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Standard: 72 h × 365 ÷ 9 = 2,920 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.
Kelly pay calculator: hours, overtime and pay a year at your hourly rate.
Kelly Schedule pros and cons
Pros
A 4-day break every 9 days.
Three shifts per 9 days, so about 56 hours a week.
Good for people who want longer breaks than a 24/48.
Cons
Three 24-hour shifts in five days are tiring.
The word "Kelly" means different things in different departments.
Your department may add Kelly days on top of this cycle.

## 24/72 Schedule Calendar 2027: 42 Hours a Week, Free
URL: https://crewdays.app/24-72-schedule/

Home / 24/72 Schedule
24/72 Schedule Calendar
On a 24/72 schedule you work one 24-hour shift and then have 72 hours off, a 4-day cycle. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
24/72 Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 4 days
Shift length: 24 hours
Crews for 24/7: 4
Hours a week: 42
Hours a year: 2,190
Days off per cycle: 3
What is a 24/72 schedule?
On a 24/72 schedule you work one 24-hour shift and then have 72 hours off, a 4-day cycle. It needs four platoons (A, B, C, D) and brings the average down to 42 hours a week.
One cycle, crew by crew
Standard (4 days)
Crew A: 24h, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, 24h
Crew C: Off, Off, 24h, Off
Crew D: Off, 24h, Off, Off
Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your 24/72 schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 4-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable 24/72 schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a 24/72 schedule
Because it needs a fourth platoon, A to D, a 24/72 takes about a third more firefighters than a 24/48 to staff each shift the same way, but it brings each person's average week down to 42 hours, close to a normal job.
Departments move to 24/72 mainly to cut fatigue and overtime: in any 28-day period it gives exactly 7 shifts, 168 hours, below the 212-hour 7(k) threshold. The cost for the department is a fourth platoon, so it is less common than the 24/48.
Because the cycle is 4 days, your shift day moves through the week; you get each weekday off in turn and about one weekend shift in every two weekends.
You never work both days of a weekend: half of all weekends are completely free and in the rest you are on either the Saturday or the Sunday. One shift of leave gives seven days off in a row, three off on each side of it.
If you move from a 24/48, expect about 92 shifts a year instead of about 122, around 2,200 scheduled hours instead of 2,920. Budget for it if callbacks and overtime made up part of your pay.
Overtime on a 24/72 schedule under 7(k)
Fire departments usually pay overtime under section 7(k) of the FLSA: after 212 hours in a 28-day work period (29 CFR 553.230). In any 28 days this cycle puts 7 shifts of 24 hours, so 168 hours, which is 44 hours under the threshold, with no 7(k) overtime before Kelly days, swaps or callbacks.
Try your own work period in the 7(k) overtime calculator.
How many hours is a 24/72 schedule?
| | Version | Cycle | Crews | Avg hours a week | Hours a year
| Standard | 4 days | 4 | 42 | 2,190
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. Standard: 24 h × 365 ÷ 4 = 2,190 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.
24/72 pay calculator: hours, overtime and pay a year at your hourly rate.
24/72 Schedule pros and cons
Pros
Three days off after every shift.
About 42 hours a week, close to a normal job.
Less overtime for the department to pay.
Cons
Needs a fourth platoon, so more staff.
Fewer shifts can mean lower pay if overtime was part of your income.
Still 24 hours on duty in one go.

## Hitch Rotation Calendar 2027: 14/14, 7/7, 21/7 (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/fifo-schedule/

Home / Hitch Rotation Schedule
Hitch Rotation Schedule Calendar
A hitch rotation (FIFO roster in Australia, fly in, fly out) is a block of 12-hour shifts on site followed by a block at home. Pick a day you start work and get your whole year.
Hitch Rotation Schedule at a glance
Cycle: 28 days
Shift length: 12 hours
Crews for 24/7: 4
Hours a week: 42
Hours a year: 2,190
Days off per cycle: 14
What is a Hitch Rotation schedule?
A hitch rotation (FIFO roster in Australia, fly in, fly out) is a block of 12-hour shifts on site followed by a block at home. The most common are 14 days on and 14 off (even time), 7 on and 7 off, 14 on and 7 off (often called 2 and 1), 21 on and 7 off, 28 on and 28 off and 8 on and 6 off. Offshore platforms, oilfields, mines and remote camps use them, and 7 on 7 off is also common in hospitals.
One cycle, crew by crew
14 on 7 off (21 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day
Crew C: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day
8 on 6 off (14 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day
14 on 14 off (28 days)
Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day

21 on 7 off (28 days)

Crew B: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day
Crew C: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day
Crew D: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day

Crew A: Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off

Employers often shift the start or swap the order of blocks. If your Hitch Rotation schedule rota differs, change the start date until the calendar matches a week you already know: the 28-day cycle then lines up for the whole year.
Printable Hitch Rotation schedule template
One full cycle for every crew. Download the PNG, or pick your start date in the calendar above and press Print for your own year, or Excel to get it as a spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
Working a Hitch Rotation schedule
On a hitch rotation the crew change date is what matters: count from it and every later hitch follows. Put your first day on site as the start date in the calendar and choose your rotation; the calendar then shows each hitch and each day at home for the whole year.
Travel days are handled differently by each employer: some count them as working days, some as days off and some pay them separately. If your travel day is part of the hitch, include it when you set the start date.
Even-time rotations (7/7, 14/14, 28/28) need two crews for each position on day shift, and four for day and night. A 14/7 needs three crews and a 21/7 four, because the time on site is longer than the time at home.
Overtime on a Hitch Rotation schedule: it depends on the workweek
Federal overtime is due for hours over 40 in a workweek, a fixed 7-day period that your employer chooses and that does not have to start on Monday (29 CFR 778.105). With the same 14 shifts every 28 days, the day it starts changes how the hours fall into weeks, and so the overtime. Crew A, cycle starting on a Monday:
| | Workweek starts | Hours in each week | Overtime hours a year
| Monday | 84, 84, 0, 0 | 1,144
| Tuesday | 84, 72, 0, 12 | 988
| Wednesday | 84, 60, 0, 24 | 832
| Thursday | 84, 48, 0, 36 | 676
| Friday | 84, 36, 0, 48 | 676
| Saturday | 84, 24, 0, 60 | 832
| Sunday | 84, 12, 0, 72 | 988
Compare this pattern with every other 24/7 option in 24/7 shift schedules compared. Federal rule only, before leave and swaps. Daily overtime states such as California count differently: use “Your pay” in the calendar or the shift pay calculator.
How many hours is a Hitch Rotation schedule?
| | Version | Cycle | Crews | Avg hours a week | Hours a year
| 14 on 7 off | 21 days | 3 | 56 | 2,920
| 8 on 6 off | 14 days | 2 | 48 | 2,502.9
| 14 on 14 off | 28 days | 2 | 42 | 2,190
| 7 on 7 off | 14 days | 2 | 42 | 2,190
| 21 on 7 off | 28 days | 4 | 63 | 3,285
| 28 on 28 off | 56 days | 2 | 42 | 2,190
Hours a year = hours worked in one cycle × 365 ÷ days in the cycle. 14 on 14 off: 168 h × 365 ÷ 28 = 2,190 h. These are scheduled hours; overtime, leave and swaps change your own total.
Hitch Rotation pay calculator: hours, overtime and pay a year at your hourly rate.
Hitch Rotation Schedule pros and cons
Pros
Long, predictable breaks at home.
Easy to plan holidays and travel around.
Even time (7/7, 14/14, 28/28) gives half the year at home.
Cons
Long stretches away from family.
Travel days are often unpaid or count as days off.
Rotations differ from site to site, so check your own crew change date.

Who uses the Hitch Rotation schedule?
Mining, oil and gas, and construction camps in Australia, Canada and offshore.

Questions
How many hours a week is a Hitch Rotation schedule?
On average 42 hours a week: 14 shifts of 12 hours every 28 days. Over a year that is about 2,190 scheduled hours, before overtime, leave or Kelly days.
How many crews does a Hitch Rotation schedule need?
2 crews for this version, with exactly one crew on each shift every day.
How many hours a year is a Hitch Rotation schedule?
About 2,190 scheduled hours a year: about 183 shifts of 12 hours. Overtime, leave and shift swaps change your own total; the pay calculator works it out at your hourly rate.
How long is the Hitch Rotation schedule cycle?
28 days. After that the same days repeat, so the calendar for any year follows from one start date.
How do I add my Hitch Rotation schedule shifts to Google Calendar or my iPhone?
Pick a day you start a block, press "Add to calendar" and open the file. It adds your Hitch Rotation schedule shifts, about 183 a year, as all-day events that Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook import, so daylight saving time does not move them.
Can my family see my schedule?
Yes. Press "Copy link" ("Share" on a phone) and send it. The link holds your Hitch Rotation schedule crew and start date, so it opens the same calendar on any phone. Nobody needs an account.
Can I download it to Excel?
Yes. Press "Excel" to download the year as a CSV file that opens in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers. With "All crews" selected you get one column for each of the 2 crews (A, B), ready to print or post for the whole team.

## Nurse Shift Schedule Calendar 2027 (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/for/nurses/

Home / Nurses
Nurse Shift Schedule Calendar
Hospital nurses mostly work 12-hour shifts, either three a week on a self-scheduled rota or on a fixed rotation such as 3 on 3 off or 2 on 2 off. Units that need the same nurses on every day of the week often use a Pitman or Panama rotation.
Shift patterns for nurses
3 on 3 off Schedule6-day cycle, 42 h a week
2 on 2 off Schedule4-day cycle, 42 h a week
4 on 4 off Schedule8-day cycle, 42 h a week
Pitman Schedule14-day cycle, 42 h a week
Panama Schedule28-day cycle, 42 h a week
Three 12s or a rotation?
Many hospital nurses are hired for 36 hours a week: three 12-hour shifts, often on days they choose through self-scheduling. Others work a fixed rotation such as 3 on 3 off or 2 on 2 off, which averages 42 hours a week. Before you compare two jobs, check which one each post means: 3 on 3 off adds about 26 shifts a year.
The 8/80 overtime rule
Hospitals and residential care facilities can agree with their staff, before the work is done, to count overtime over a 14-day period instead of a week. Overtime is then due for hours over 8 in a workday and over 80 in the 14 days, at time and a half (29 CFR 778.601, section 7(j) of the FLSA). On 12-hour shifts that means 4 hours of overtime on every shift, so ask payroll whether you are on 8/80 or on the normal 40-hour workweek.
Weekends and holidays
Many units ask nurses to work a share of weekends and rotate the major holidays. Choose "All crews" to see which team has each weekend; US federal holidays are marked, so you can count the ones you work and compare them with your unit's holiday rotation.
Tips
If you work three 12s a week on changing days, use "Build your own" and type one or two weeks of your rota.
Choose "All crews" to see which team covers each day when you plan swaps.
Share the link with your family so they see your days off without asking.
In California, choose the California overtime rule in "Your pay": a 12-hour shift has 4 hours of overtime. Hospitals can adopt 12-hour alternative workweeks (IWC Wage Order 5): then pick that rule instead.
In Alaska, hospital employees who provide medical services are exempt from daily overtime (AS 23.10.060(d)(12)).
See your yearly hours and pay on the shift pay calculator.

## Firefighter Shift Calendar 2027: A/B/C Shift Generator (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/for/firefighters/

Home / Firefighters
Firefighter Shift Calendar (A, B, C Shift)
Most US fire departments run 24-hour shifts with three platoons, usually called A, B and C shift, on a 24/48, 48/96 or Kelly rotation. Departments moving to four platoons use the 24/72.
Shift patterns for firefighters
24/48 Schedule3-day cycle, 56 h a week
48/96 Schedule6-day cycle, 56 h a week
Kelly Schedule9-day cycle, 56 h a week
24/72 Schedule4-day cycle, 42 h a week
Who is covered by 7(k)
The 7(k) overtime rules cover fire department employees who are trained in fire suppression, have the legal authority and responsibility to fight fires, and respond to fires and emergencies. That includes paramedics, EMTs and rescue workers employed by the fire department who meet those conditions (29 CFR 553.210). Civilian dispatchers, mechanics and clerks are not covered and get overtime after 40 hours a week.
Trading shifts
Two firefighters can swap shifts voluntarily, with the department's approval. The hours worked as a substitute are left out of the overtime count, and each person is credited as if they had worked their normal schedule (29 CFR 553.31). The swap must be freely chosen: the department can suggest it but cannot penalise anyone who refuses.
Holidays on a three-platoon schedule
On a 24/48 each platoon works one day in three, so every holiday is worked by one platoon. Because a normal year has 365 days, the platoon that works a fixed-date holiday such as July 4 changes from one year to the next. Choose "All crews" and change the year to see who works each holiday.
Tips
Choose "All crews" for the classic station calendar with one colour per platoon.
Kelly days (extra days off to cut weekly hours) differ by department: under "Kelly days" pick how often yours come, for example every 7th shift, and they show on the calendar and in your hours and pay.
Press "Excel" with "All crews" selected to download the A, B and C shift year for the station board.
Press "Embed" to put "who is on duty today" and the next 14 days on your department or union website. It is free and updates itself every day.
The calendar file adds each 24-hour shift as an all-day event, so it does not move at daylight saving time.
Work out 7(k) overtime for your work period.

## Police Shift Schedule Calendar 2027 (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/for/police/

Home / Police officers
Police Shift Schedule Calendar
Police departments that patrol around the clock work 8-, 10- or 12-hour shifts. With 12-hour shifts, four squads can cover every day on a Pitman (2-2-3), Panama or 4 on 4 off rotation; the DuPont adds a full week off every four weeks.
Shift patterns for police officers
Pitman Schedule14-day cycle, 42 h a week
Panama Schedule28-day cycle, 42 h a week
4 on 4 off Schedule8-day cycle, 42 h a week
DuPont Schedule28-day cycle, 42 h a week
4-3-3-4 Schedule14-day cycle, 42 h a week
Overtime for police under 7(k)
A public agency can pay law enforcement officers overtime on a work period of 7 to 28 days instead of the 40-hour week: overtime is due after 171 hours in 28 days, 86 in 14 days or 43 in 7 days (29 CFR 553.230). The rule covers officers empowered by law to enforce laws and keep the peace, with the power to arrest and the training that goes with it, whatever their rank (29 CFR 553.211). Typical examples are city police, sheriffs' deputies, state troopers and highway patrol officers.
12-hour patrol and the work period
A Pitman rotation works 84 hours every 14 days. On a 14-day work period the threshold is 86 hours, so the schedule itself creates no overtime. On a 7-day work period, every week with four or more 12-hour shifts (48 hours or more) passes the 43-hour threshold.
Correctional officers
Security personnel in jails and prisons, meaning staff responsible for controlling and maintaining custody of inmates, are treated as law enforcement under 7(k) and use the same 171-hour standard (29 CFR 553.211(f) and 553.230(b)). Staff in culinary, maintenance, teaching or medical services in the facility are not included and get overtime after 40 hours a week (29 CFR 553.211(g)).
Trading shifts
Two officers of the same agency can swap shifts if both agree freely and the agency approves. The hours worked as a substitute are left out of the overtime count, and each officer is credited with their normal schedule (29 CFR 553.31).
Tips
Choose "All crews" to see which squad is on patrol each day.
If you work four 10-hour shifts and three days off, use "Build your own" and type DDDDOOO (D for a day shift, N for nights, O for a day off).
Copy the link to share your schedule with your family; it opens on any phone without an account.
See your yearly hours and pay on the shift pay calculator.
Work out 7(k) overtime for your work period.

## 911 Dispatcher Shift Schedule Calendar 2027 (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/for/dispatchers/

Home / 911 dispatchers
911 Dispatcher Shift Schedule Calendar
Emergency communication centers answer calls 24 hours a day, so 911 dispatchers and telecommunicators usually work 12-hour rotations such as the Pitman (2-2-3), Panama, 4 on 4 off or 2 on 2 off, or 8- and 10-hour shifts on fixed days.
Shift patterns for 911 dispatchers
Pitman Schedule14-day cycle, 42 h a week
Panama Schedule28-day cycle, 42 h a week
4 on 4 off Schedule8-day cycle, 42 h a week
2 on 2 off Schedule4-day cycle, 42 h a week
DuPont Schedule28-day cycle, 42 h a week
Do dispatchers get 7(k) overtime?
Usually not. Civilian dispatchers and radio operators of police and fire departments are expressly left out of the 7(k) rules (29 CFR 553.210(b) and 553.211(g)). They are paid overtime under the standard rule: time and a half for hours over 40 in a workweek.
Why weekly hours change on a 12-hour rotation
A 12-hour rotation does not fit the 7-day week, so the number of shifts in a workweek changes: on a Pitman, between two and five (24 to 60 hours). Every hour over 40 in a workweek is overtime under the standard rule; the pay estimate on each calendar counts it week by week for your start date.
Trading shifts in a public agency
If your center is run by a public agency, two dispatchers can swap shifts voluntarily with the agency's approval, and the substitute hours are left out of the overtime count (29 CFR 553.31).
Tips
Choose "All crews" to see which team is on the floor each day.
Turn on "Your pay" to see weekly overtime under the standard 40-hour rule for your start date.
Copy the link to share your schedule with your family.

## EMS Shift Schedule Calendar 2027 (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/for/ems/

Home / Paramedics and EMTs
EMS Shift Schedule Calendar
EMS crews work either 24-hour shifts, often on a 24/48 or 24/72 rotation when the service is part of a fire department, or 12-hour shifts on rotations such as 4 on 4 off or the Pitman (2-2-3), common in hospital-based and private ambulance services.
Shift patterns for paramedics and EMTs
24/48 Schedule3-day cycle, 56 h a week
24/72 Schedule4-day cycle, 42 h a week
48/96 Schedule6-day cycle, 56 h a week
4 on 4 off Schedule8-day cycle, 42 h a week
Pitman Schedule14-day cycle, 42 h a week
Kelly Schedule9-day cycle, 56 h a week
Which overtime rule applies to EMS
Paramedics, EMTs and ambulance personnel employed by a municipal, county or state fire department who are trained in fire suppression and have the authority to fight fires fall under the fire protection rules: overtime after 212 hours in 28 days (29 CFR 553.210(a) and 553.230). Ambulance staff who are an integral part of a public agency's law enforcement activities use the law enforcement standard of 171 hours (29 CFR 553.211(b)). The 7(k) exemption is only for public agencies (29 CFR 553.201), so EMTs and paramedics at private ambulance companies are paid overtime after 40 hours in a workweek.
24-hour shifts and sleep time
On duty periods of 24 hours or more, employer and employee may agree to exclude meal periods and a regular sleeping period of up to 8 hours from hours worked, if the employer provides adequate sleeping facilities and the employee can usually get an uninterrupted night's sleep. Without such an agreement, the sleeping time counts as hours worked (29 CFR 785.22).

## Shift Rota Calendar 2027 UK: 4 on 4 off, Continental (Free)
URL: https://crewdays.app/uk/

Home / UK
Your shift rota for the whole year
Pick your rota and a day you start work. You get all 12 months with UK bank holidays, your hours, a link to share and a file for your phone calendar.
Rotas
4 on 4 off Rota16-day cycle, 42 h a weekA 4 on 4 off rota is four 12-hour shifts followed by four days off, an 8-day cycle, so your working days move through the week.
Continental Shift Pattern8-day cycle, 42 h a weekThe continental shift pattern is 2 days, 2 nights and 4 days off on 12-hour shifts, an 8-day cycle for four teams.
2-2-3 Rota (Pitman)14-day cycle, 42 h a weekThe 2-2-3 rota, also called the Pitman, repeats every 14 days: 2 on, 2 off, 3 on, 2 off, 2 on, 3 off on 12-hour shifts.
3 on 3 off Rota12-day cycle, 42 h a weekA 3 on 3 off rota is three 12-hour shifts and three days off.
2 on 2 off Rota8-day cycle, 42 h a weekA 2 on 2 off rota is two 12-hour shifts and two days off.
DuPont Rota28-day cycle, 42 h a weekThe DuPont rota is a 28-day pattern of 12-hour shifts for four teams: 4 nights, 3 off, 3 days, 1 off, 3 nights, 3 off, 4 days, then 7 days off.
Earlies, Lates and Nights Rota28-day cycle, 42 h a weekAn earlies, lates and nights rota rotates 8-hour shifts: here 7 earlies, 2 off, 7 lates, 2 off, 7 nights, 3 off, a 28-day cycle for four teams.
Do these rotas meet the Working Time Regulations?
| | Rota | Average week (reg. 4: 48 h) | Shortest gap between shifts (reg. 10: 11 h) | Weekly rest (reg. 11) | Holiday (5.6 weeks)

| Continental Shift Pattern | 42 h: Meets it | 12 h: Meets it | Meets it | 235.2 h

| 3 on 3 off Rota | 42 h: Meets it | 12 h: Meets it | Meets it | 235.2 h
| 2 on 2 off Rota | 42 h: Meets it | 12 h: Meets it | Meets it | 235.2 h
| DuPont Rota | 42 h: Meets it | 12 h: Meets it | Meets it | 235.2 h
| Earlies, Lates and Nights Rota | 42 h: Meets it | 16 h: Meets it | Meets it | 235.2 h
A guide, worked out with assumed start times (12-hour shifts 07:00 and 19:00; 8-hour shifts 06:00, 14:00 and 22:00). Does it show UK bank holidays?
Yes: England and Wales, Scotland or Northern Ireland. Choose under "Holidays shown". Substitute days are included when a bank holiday falls on a weekend.
Do I get paid extra for working a bank holiday?
Only if your contract says so. UK law gives no right to time off or extra pay on bank holidays; they can count towards your 5.6 weeks of holiday.

Working on a bank holiday
There is no legal right to have bank holidays off or to be paid more for working them. Employers can count them towards the 5.6 weeks of paid holiday (Working Time Regulations, regs. 13 and 13A). Many contracts pay time and a half or double time, or give a day off in lieu: check yours.
Dates are worked out from the rules for each holiday and the substitute-day rule. The government can add a one-off bank holiday by proclamation, so check gov.uk before you plan around a date.
Figures are worked out from each cycle; rules checked against official sources on 17 October 2026. How we calculate
Questions
What happens when a bank holiday falls on a weekend?
A substitute day is given, usually the next Monday. When Christmas Day and Boxing Day both fall on a weekend, the substitute days are the following Monday and Tuesday.
Does Scotland have different bank holidays?
Yes: 2 January and St Andrew's Day, the summer bank holiday on the first Monday of August and no Easter Monday.

## Working Time Regulations for Shift Workers (UK Guide)
URL: https://crewdays.app/uk/working-time-rules-shift-workers/

UK / Working time
Working time rules for shift workers
The Working Time Regulations 1998 set the limits for shift work in Great Britain. Northern Ireland has its own regulations with the same limits.
The main limits
| | Rule | Limit | Regulation
| Weekly working time | 48 hours on average, usually over 17 weeks; you can opt out in writing | 4 and 5
| Night work | 8 hours in 24 on average; no opt-out | 6
| Rest between shifts | 11 hours in a row in each 24 hours | 10
| Weekly rest | 24 hours in each 7 days, or 48 hours in each 14 | 11
| Breaks | 20 minutes when the day is over 6 hours | 12
| Paid holiday | 5.6 weeks a year (28 days for a 5-day week) | 13 and 13A
Shift workers changing shift can miss the daily or weekly rest when the rota does not allow it, but must get compensatory rest (reg. 22). Source: legislation.gov.uk.
Holiday on a shift rota
Your statutory holiday is 5.6 times your average week. On a 42-hour rota that is 235.2 hours, or 19.6 twelve-hour shifts. Bank holidays do not have to be given as extra paid leave: your employer can count them as part of the 5.6 weeks (GOV.UK). Statutory leave is capped at 28 days, so working 6 days a week does not add more.
If your hours change from one pay period to the next (irregular hours) or there are weeks of the year when you do not work and are not paid (part-year), leave for leave years starting on or after 1 April 2024 builds up with the hours you work instead of being a fixed number of days.
Night workers
You are a night worker if you regularly work at least 3 hours in the night period, which is 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. unless you and your employer agree in writing on another 7-hour period that includes midnight to 5 a.m. (reg. 2).
Night workers must not work more than 8 hours in each 24 on average, usually over 17 weeks. You cannot opt out of this limit (reg. 6).
Your employer must offer a free health assessment before you start night work and at regular intervals after that. You do not have to accept it (reg. 7).
If a health professional confirms that night work is affecting your health, your employer must offer you suitable day work where possible.
There is no higher legal rate for nights: the National Minimum Wage is the same. Night pay comes from your contract.
Source: GOV.UK, night working hours.
When the limits do not apply
The night work limit and the daily and weekly rest rules do not apply in jobs that need round-the-clock staffing, such as hospitals, in security and surveillance, in industries with busy peak periods, in emergencies, or where a collective or workforce agreement changes them (regs. 21 and 23). The armed forces and emergency services usually fall outside the night limits too.
In those cases you must get compensatory rest: the same length of rest that you missed, taken later. GOV.UK puts the total at a minimum of 90 hours of rest a week on average, on top of breaks at work (compensatory rest). This is why many 12-hour rotas in the NHS or in plants can break the 11-hour rule on a changeover day and still be legal.
Workers under 18
Young workers above school leaving age get a 30-minute break when they work more than 4.5 hours, 12 hours of daily rest and 48 hours of weekly rest (GOV.UK). Their working time is limited to 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week (reg. 5A), so most 12-hour rotas are not open to them.
Check your own rota
The UK rota calendar checks seven common rotas against the 48-hour average, the 11-hour rest and the weekly rest, and shows every bank holiday you work. The bank holiday list covers England and Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland for 2026 to 2028.
Figures are worked out from each cycle; rules checked against official sources on 17 October 2026. How we calculate
Questions
Is it legal to work more than 48 hours a week on shifts?
Only if you have signed an opt-out. Without it, your hours must average 48 a week or less over the reference period, usually 17 weeks.
Do I need 11 hours between shifts?
Yes, as a rule. A rota that moves you from nights straight to days can break it, which is only allowed with compensatory rest.

## About | Crewdays
URL: https://crewdays.app/about/

Home / About Crewdays
About Crewdays
A free calendar and pay tools for people who work rotating shifts, checked against official sources.
Crewdays turns a shift pattern into a calendar for the whole year. It was made by Asier Fernández because most shift calendars online cover a single pattern or ask you to sign up.
How the calendar is worked out
Each pattern is a cycle of days, for example 14 days for the Pitman. From the day you start a block, Crewdays counts forward and back through the cycle, so every date of the year gets its shift. Hours are scheduled hours: the shift length times the shifts worked. Holidays are the 11 US federal holidays (5 U.S.C. 6103) on their actual date.
Check it against your rota
Employers adapt patterns: they change the order of blocks, the start time or add relief days. Crewdays is a planning tool, not your official schedule. If something does not match, tell us and we will look at it.
How it is tested
Before every update, an automated test suite runs against the same code your browser uses. It checks that each 24/7 pattern puts exactly one crew on every shift on every day of the cycle, the US federal holidays and UK bank holidays for 2026 to 2028, the night shift hours at each clock change, the 7(k) overtime thresholds for every work period from 7 to 28 days, the pay and overtime calculations, and that the calendar file follows the iCalendar standard (RFC 5545) so Google, Apple and Outlook import it correctly. If a test fails, the update is not published.
Where the rules come from
Every pay or working-time rule on the site is taken from the official text and linked from the page that uses it:
Federal overtime, regular rate and hours worked: 29 CFR Part 778 and Part 785.
Firefighters and police (section 7(k)), sleep time and 911 dispatchers: 29 CFR Part 553.
State daily overtime: California Labor Code 510 and 511, Alaska Statutes 23.10.060 and the Colorado Overtime and Minimum Pay Standards Order (COMPS Order #40, 7 CCR 1103-1).
US federal holidays: 5 U.S.C. 6103. Clock changes: 15 U.S.C. 260a.
United Kingdom: the Working Time Regulations 1998, GOV.UK guidance and the official bank holiday list.
Rules were last checked on October 17, 2026. Union contracts, state laws and employer policies often give more than these minimums, so the site always says which rule it applied.
Corrections
If a date, a number or a rule is wrong, email us with the page and what you expected. Confirmed mistakes are fixed and the page date is updated.
Independence and funding
Crewdays is not linked to any employer, union, fire department or hospital. It is free to use and is paid for by ads shown by Google AdSense. Advertisers do not choose or review what the pages say.
Contact
asierfernandezmotilva@gmail.com

## Pitman vs DuPont Schedule: Hours, Days Off and Which Is Better
URL: https://crewdays.app/pitman-vs-dupont/

Home / Pitman vs DuPont
Pitman vs DuPont schedule
Both average 42 hours a week on 12-hour shifts with four crews. The Pitman spreads the time off evenly (never more than 3 days on or off), while the DuPont saves it up into a 7-day break every four weeks, paid for with blocks of 4 shifts and quick swaps between nights and days.
Side by side
| | Point | Pitman | DuPont
| Shift length | 12 h | 12 h
| Cycle | 14 days | 28 days
| Crews for 24/7 | 4 | 4
| Shifts a year | 182.5 | 182.5
| Hours a week | 42 | 42
| Hours a year | 2,190 | 2,190
| Most shifts in a row | 3 | 4
| Longest break | 3 days | 7 days
| Full weekends off in 2027* | 26 | 26
*For one crew, with the cycle starting on Monday, January 4, 2027. Other crews and start days get a different count.
Both cycles, day by day
Pitman
Crew A: Day, Day, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day
DuPont
Crew A: Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off
Crew C: Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night
Crew D: Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Off, Night, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Off, Night, Night, Night, Off, Off, Off, Day, Day, Day, Day
Pitman Schedule calendar DuPont Schedule calendar
Which one suits you
Both put four crews on 12-hour shifts and average 42 hours a week, so yearly pay at the same hourly rate is almost the same. The difference is how the time off is arranged.
Choose the Pitman for short blocks and regular weekends: never more than three shifts in a row and a three-day weekend off every other week. It also works with crews fixed on days or on nights, so people who cannot rotate can stay on one shift.
Choose the DuPont if a full week off every four weeks matters more: with 4 shifts of leave it becomes 14 days off in a row. Expect blocks of four shifts, a quick change from days to nights in the middle of the cycle and more weekly overtime, because some weeks have 72 hours and others none.
How to choose
Put both patterns side by side in the calendar with your own start date: weekends off, holidays worked and pay depend on where your crew sits in the cycle, not only on the pattern. Then compare yearly pay at your hourly rate in the shift pay calculator, which applies federal and state overtime.
Figures are worked out from each cycle; rules checked against official sources on October 17, 2026. How we calculate
Questions
Is the Pitman or the DuPont schedule better?
Both average 42 hours a week on 12-hour shifts with four crews. The Pitman spreads the time off evenly (never more than 3 days on or off), while the DuPont saves it up into a 7-day break every four weeks, paid for with blocks of 4 shifts and quick swaps between nights and days.
Which has more days off, Pitman or DuPont?
7 days off every 14 days on the Pitman and 14 every 28 on the DuPont. Hours a week: 42 and 42.

## 48/96 vs 24/48 Schedule: Hours, Days Off and Which Is Better
URL: https://crewdays.app/48-96-vs-24-48/

Home / 48/96 vs 24/48
48/96 vs 24/48 schedule
Same hours (about 56 a week, 2,920 a year) and the same three platoons. The 48/96 joins two shifts into a 48-hour stretch and gives four days off in a row, so there are half as many commutes. The 24/48 keeps each stretch at 24 hours, which many find easier to recover from.
Side by side
| | Point | 48/96 | 24/48
| Shift length | 24 h | 24 h
| Cycle | 6 days | 3 days
| Crews for 24/7 | 3 | 3
| Shifts a year | 121.7 | 121.7
| Hours a week | 56 | 56
| Hours a year | 2,920 | 2,920
| Most shifts in a row | 2 | 1
| Longest break | 4 days | 2 days
| Full weekends off in 2027* | 25 | 18
*For one crew, with the cycle starting on Monday, January 4, 2027. Other crews and start days get a different count.
Both cycles, day by day
48/96
Crew A: 24h, 24h, Off, Off, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, Off, Off, 24h, 24h
Crew C: Off, Off, 24h, 24h, Off, Off
24/48
Crew A: 24h, Off, Off
Crew B: Off, Off, 24h
Crew C: Off, 24h, Off
48/96 Schedule calendar 24/48 Schedule calendar
Which one suits you
Both use three platoons and the same 56-hour average week, and both put 9 or 10 shifts into any 28-day 7(k) work period, so overtime and pay are about the same.
The 48/96 halves the trips to the station: about 61 commutes a year instead of about 122. That matters most for firefighters who live an hour or more away. You also get four days off in a row every six days.
The 24/48 keeps each stretch at 24 hours, so a bad night is followed by two days off rather than another 24 hours on duty. Swaps are easier too, because a colleague covers one shift, not two.
How to choose
Put both patterns side by side in the calendar with your own start date: weekends off, holidays worked and pay depend on where your crew sits in the cycle, not only on the pattern. Then compare yearly pay at your hourly rate in the shift pay calculator, which applies federal and state overtime.
Figures are worked out from each cycle; rules checked against official sources on October 17, 2026. How we calculate
Questions
Is the 48/96 or the 24/48 schedule better?
Same hours (about 56 a week, 2,920 a year) and the same three platoons. The 48/96 joins two shifts into a 48-hour stretch and gives four days off in a row, so there are half as many commutes. The 24/48 keeps each stretch at 24 hours, which many find easier to recover from.
Which has more days off, 48/96 or 24/48?
4 days off every 6 days on the 48/96 and 2 every 3 on the 24/48. Hours a week: 56 and 56.
